Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot. Source `src/`; tests colocated `*.test.ts`; docs `docs/`; plugins `extensions/*`; built output `dist/`. Keep plugin-only deps in the extension `package.json`; do not add them to the root `package.json` unless core uses them. Consider all built-in + extension channels when refactoring shared logic. Docs links in `docs/**/*.md` are root-relative, no `.md`/`.mdx`; when Peter asks for links, use full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. When touching docs, end reply with URLs referenced. Docs must be generic; use placeholders. README docs links stay absolute.

Node 22+; keep Node + Bun paths working. `pnpm install`; also `bun install` (keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` + Bun patching in sync when touching deps/patches). Prefer `bun <file.ts>` / `bunx <tool>`. CLI: `pnpm clawdbot ...` or `pnpm dev`. Run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test`; coverage `pnpm test:coverage`. TypeScript ESM; avoid `any`. Add brief comments for tricky logic. Keep files concise; split when clarity/testability improves. Tests match `*.test.ts`; e2e `*.e2e.test.ts`. Run `pnpm test` before pushing logic changes.

Never commit or publish real phone numbers, videos, or live configuration values. Never update the Carbon dependency. Any dependency with `pnpm.patchedDependencies` must use an exact version (no `^`/`~`). Patching dependencies (pnpm patches, overrides, or vendored changes) requires explicit approval; do not do this by default. Never ed
